revenue.source: financial_statements, ifrs-full:Revenue, KONE ESEF reports 2138001CNF45JP5XZK38-2024-12-31-ESEF-FI-0 and -2025-12-31-ESEF-FI-0

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 revenue CAGR was about 1.3% (filed); modest acceleration to low-to-mid single digit on service/modernization mix, fading toward terminal growth. Analyst judgment, not guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 11.9% (1336.2/11245.2, filed), up from 11.0% in FY2023; hold about 12.0% for conservatism.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 pretax income 1326.8 vs net income 980.1 implies about 26% total tax/minorities; use 24% as approx. Finnish statutory 20% plus foreign mix. Not a filed rate.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A 319.9/11245.2 = 2.8% (filed); includes right-of-use depreciation, so exceeds PP&E capex.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 capex 1.4-1.5% of revenue (filed PP&E purchases); excludes intangibles and leases.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = ECB 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (2026-11-05) + beta 1.0 (assumed, industry beta not retrieved) x Finland ERP 4.586% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = 7.85%; low leverage so WACC about 7.7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro area inflation/growth, below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: INCOMPLETE: total debt not found (tool returned null for borrowings; KONE uses extension concepts). Value is only minus cash and equivalents 440.5 (ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents, FY2025 ESEF) with debt assumed 0 as a placeholder. Reviewer must supply borrowings excl. leases.

diluted_shares.source: Derived: FY2025 net income attributable to owners 980.1M / diluted EPS 1.89 (ESEF 2138001CNF45JP5XZK38-2025-12-31-ESEF-FI-0); weighted diluted share count not returned by tool. Millions of shares.
